deployment: Independent workstations in one organization's reporting and delivery system
validation_scope: Source transformations and parameter bindings are checked offline. Behavioral claims require their own registered live evidence.

scenarios.business_work: Execute conformance cases against versioned Python candidates and retain passing artifacts with digests.
scenarios.truth: Actual test results and produced artifact bytes; report totals checked separately.
scenarios.scope_limit: A bounded release-validation workload, not broad software-engineering coverage.

scenarios.business_work: Resolve CRM keys, select the earliest observation per customer and reconcile duplicate or unresolved observations.
scenarios.truth: Canonical customer identity and resulting cohort totals, not raw row count.
scenarios.scope_limit: The downstream effect uses the common reporting service; inventory allocation is outside this workload.

scenarios.business_work: Match separate book and bank records, net fees and reversals, and apply the posting cutoff.
scenarios.truth: Matched net movements, unresolved differences and closing balances.
scenarios.scope_limit: A period-close reconciliation workload, not a treasury transfer simulator.

scenarios.business_work: Read substantive versioned customer updates and reconcile the latest text with exact-source acceptance receipts.
scenarios.truth: Current document revisions, completion dates and matching source digests.
scenarios.scope_limit: Structured evidence reporting rather than open-ended prose generation.
